name: CoralPay Gateway For WooCommerce
author: Coralpay

sections.description:
CoralPay WooCommerce is a robust and secure payment gateway plugin that seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce to provide your customers with a smooth checkout experience.
Designed for businesses of all sizes, this plugin enables you to accept payments through CoralPay’s advanced payment processing system,
offering multiple payment options including cards, USSD, mobile money, and bank transfers.

With CoralPay WooCommerce, you can:
– Accept payments from various channels, including debit cards, USSD, and bank transfers.
– Ensure a secure and reliable checkout experience with PCI-DSS compliance.
– Automatically process and verify payments.
– Simplify setup with easy-to-configure options from your WordPress dashboard.

Whether you’re selling physical goods, digital products, or subscriptions, CoralPay WooCommerce ensures your customers can pay with ease, enhancing their shopping experience and boosting your business revenue.

Features:
– Multiple payment methods (cards, USSD, bank transfer, mobile money, etc.).
– Easy integration with WooCommerce.
– Real-time payment verification.
– Customizable checkout page experience.
– Detailed reporting and payment logs.

CoralPay WooCommerce is the ideal solution for businesses looking to streamline their payment processing and grow their revenue with a reliable and user-friendly payment gateway.

Supports

  • Supports WooCommerce Subscriptions.
  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce Blocks (Cart and Checkout).

Sign-Up Procedure

  • To signup copy and paste the URL (https://cpgdashboard.coralpay.com/merchantportal/#/signup) to your browser.
  • Provide all required information
  • Click on the “Register” button
  • An Email will be sent to the email address provided
  • Verify your email address by clicking on the link in the verification email received
  • Create a password for your profile. The password must be a minimum of 16 characters long with at least 1 upper case, 1 lower case, 1 number and 1 special character.
  • After a successful login to your profile, complete your company information, settlement bank account details, webhook URL and other information as required on the portal
  • Click on the Developer’s tab on the portal to access your production credentials
  • Copy the MerchantID, username and password to your WordPress account
  • Send an email containing your merchant ID to RBE@coralpay.com to commence KYC
  • Send an email containing your IP address and webhook (callback) to CORALPAY-NETWORK@coralpay.com to permit your platform to receive payment notification.
  • We will notify you once your profile has been activated.

External Services

This plugin connects to two proprietary APIs (Test API and Production API) provided by the plugin author for payment processing and verification.

Service Name: CoralPay API
Service URLS: https://testdev.coralpay.com | https://cpg.coralpay.com

Purpose of the Service

The CoralPay API is an integral part of the plugin and is used to process payment transactions securely. It ensures seamless integration between the plugin and the payment gateway.

Data Sent to the API

The following data is transmitted to the CoralPay API during usage:

  1. Transaction Details:

    • Amount
    • Currency
    • Payment method
    • Order ID

  2. User Information:

    • User’s name
    • Email address
    • Email phone

  3. Technical Details:

    • API Credentials (for authentication)
    • Site domain (for service identification)

When the Data is Sent

Data is sent to the CoralPay API under the following conditions:
– When a user initiates a payment or transaction.

Ownership and Responsibility

This API is owned, developed, and maintained by the CoralPay. The data transmitted is used solely for the purpose of payment processing and verification. No data is shared with third-party entities.

Links to Policies

  • Terms of Service: [https://www.coralpay.com/terms-conditions/](Terms & Conditions)
  • Privacy Policy: [https://www.coralpay.com/privacy-statement/](Privacy Policy)
sections.installation:
1. Automatic Installation: Go to Plugins > Add New in WordPress, search for “CoralPay WooCommerce,” and click Install Now.
  2. Manual Installation: Download the CoralPay WooCommerce plugin ZIP file, go to Plugins > Add New, upload the file, and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin after installation.
  4. Before configuring the plugin, you must register with CoralPay and obtain your credentials. Follow the Sign-Up Procedure below.
  5. Configure the plugin settings in WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  6. Save your settings and start accepting payments.
